payload.summary: Favourites presents hard-coded prototype fixtures as the clinician's own saved items and activity
payload.detail: favourites-prototype-data.ts is imported by the production favourites-hub.tsx:31 and favourites-command-library-page.tsx:46, not only by mockups. The page asserts '5 favourites' and 'last opened Today 08:44' with no demo label. 'Last opened' is a factual claim about the clinician's own behaviour. Needs one line of owner confirmation on whether this is an accepted prototype surface.
